facts: Parties: Foxley Marine Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Bioscience plc (Seller); the Company is Netherby Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 5 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
